verdict.rationale: Controlling data retention and deletion is a fair question for a cloud platform, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of retention policies, deletion controls, soft-delete, or data purge capabilities. Its items cover CLI installation, IaC, RBAC, cost management, emulators and lifecycle/support policies, none of which concern customer data retention.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
